name: handoff
description: Keeps a short handoff note per repository (the work, what was done, what is next, open problems), written by claude-haiku-5-5 after turns that do real work, and hands it to Claude at session start and after each compaction

enabled.title: Handoff notes
enabled.description: Off: no note is written or shown.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that writes the note: an alias or a full model id. Called through Claude Code, on the signed-in account.

minTools.title: Tool calls that count as work
minTools.description: A turn that edits no file updates the note only when Claude made at least this many tool calls in it. 1 to 100.

minSecondsBetween.title: Seconds between notes
minSecondsBetween.description: The note is written at most once in this many seconds. Turns in between are kept and go into the next note. 0 to 3600.

timeoutSeconds.title: Model timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: The model call is given up after this long, and the old note stays. 2 to 60.
